title: Property intake form
description: The Director's intake form, one per property; stored only in the private site repo as ops/intake.json, never in canon (canon holds only the fictional FIXTURE). The form carries NO secrets: no API key, token, password or SID belongs in any field, and the validator rejects secret-shaped values.

property_code.description: Three-letter uppercase code; the system uses it to name the property's lanes, files and facts keys and to tell it apart from siblings.

domain.description: Lowercase hostname the site is served from; the system needs it for canonical URLs, sitemaps and schema markup.

display_name.description: Business name as shown to visitors; the system renders it in titles, headers and structured data.

city.description: Home city of the business; the system anchors local copy, the address block and market research on it.

state.description: Two-letter uppercase state code; the system needs it to pick the energy code, utilities and programs to research.

service_area_towns.description: Towns the property will serve; the system builds one town page per entry and requires each to appear in the market pack. May be empty, meaning research decides.

services.description: Services the business offers, as slugs from the portfolio's shared list; the system builds service pages and navigation only for these.

tracking_phone.description: Public call-tracking number in E.164 form; the system renders it on every page and in click-to-call links so calls are attributed to this property.

lead_destination.description: Where form leads are delivered; the system routes each submitted lead here. Either the address object, stored only in the private site repo (ops/intake.json) and never in canon, or a server-copy reference string of the form server-copy:<PROPERTY_CODE>:LEAD_TO, meaning the actual destination lives only in the server copy and is never written here as a literal. Addresses and numbers only: no API key, token, password or SID.

emails.description: At least one email address that receives each lead; the system needs one so no lead is dropped.

sms.description: E.164 numbers that get a text alert per lead; may be empty when no text alert is wanted.

then.description: Server-copy reference: three-letter uppercase property code, then LEAD_TO. The destination itself lives only in the server copy, never as a literal value here. Wrapped in anyOf so a rejected string is never echoed in the error.

sibling_properties.description: Property codes of portfolio siblings; the system uses them to avoid cross-property duplication and to share canon. May be empty; must not include this property's own code.

industry_pack.description: Industry content pack to build from; the system selects page templates, service vocabulary and research checklists by it.

launch_notes.description: Free-text notes for the launch session; the system passes them to the builder as context. May be empty. No secrets.

e164.description: Phone number in E.164 form, e.g. +15555550123.
